sortieLines.line: ⚔️ SORTIE — Onni, Henry take up arms and a day's rations (4,030 kcal from the stores) and walk out to the treeline. Nobody's coming back the same.
⚔️ The Influencer mauled Onni (-67 health) over 3 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing. — the party falls back to the palisade, dragging their nerve with them. The treeline holds.
🌙 Night. Shouts from the treeline — Amara of Stonebridge with 3 others, and they're not here to talk. "Your pantry or your blood. Choose." (They want ~2,000 kcal.)
📓 Codex: Amara of Stonebridge raids Haven's treeline — demands ~2,000 kcal.
